title: Cities in the Shell
summary: 2 a.m. oyster bar; each opened shell holds a tiny lit city; she squeezes lemon over one and sets it aside. Tonight's selection is a little metropolitan. Vivienne.
visualArc: Black marble → nacre cities → lemon bead over a boulevard → dark-ocean shell kept.
